about: Vectors for calls between machines of one estate over the relay (DEC-0106), written by tools/vectors/machine-call.ts, never by hand. Absent values are absent members; null is a JSON null. profile: machineProfile(record, machineId), null for none; a case without record reads the file's record. caller: relayCallerTier(input), input.applied the file's record unless the case names its own, every revocation in input.revocations a delta's. verdict: machineCallVerdict(input). open: openAgentCall(sealed, context) with schemaValid the agent-call-message schema; context.own.privateKey is the base64 P-256 scalar. seal: sealAgentCall(message, context), context.ephemeral the hex ephemeral scalar. A sealed call is HPKE base mode, suite [16, 1, 1], info the ASCII fabric-agent-call/1, the additional data the RFC 8785 UTF-8 bytes of {type, kind, from, to, msgId, kem}, the plaintext the RFC 8785 form of the message; enc and ct are unpadded base64url. Every case holds in every time zone.
